PrivacyPolicy.GoviCarePrivacy: GoViCare is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application designed to provide farming guidance, asset management, weather reports, monitoring support, and a public forum for farmers. By using our App, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of our App.
PrivacyPolicy.RegistrationInformationText: To use our App, you must register by providing your name, contact details, address, and other personal information. Bank details may also be collected for specific features, such as financial planning or asset management.
PrivacyPolicy.LocationInformationText: We collect your location data to provide weather reports and tailored farming advice. This data is collected only when you enable location services.
PrivacyPolicy.UsageDataText: We collect information about your interaction with our App, including features accessed, activity logs, and preferences to improve our services and provide better recommendations. Public Forum Content: Any information shared by you in the public forum, such as issues, questions, or advice, is public and may be visible to other users. Please do not share sensitive information in this forum.
PrivacyPolicy.ToProvideServicesText: We use your information to deliver farming guidance, weather reports, asset management, and support features.
PrivacyPolicy.WeatherAndLocationServicesText: Your location is used to provide accurate weather updates relevant to your area.
PrivacyPolicy.AccountManagementText: Your details, including bank information, are used to manage your account and facilitate asset-related services.
PrivacyPolicy.PublicForumText: Information shared in the forum is used to create a collaborative environment where farmers can interact and solve problems.
PrivacyPolicy.ResearchAndDevelopmentText: We use aggregated data to improve our services, including app features and user experience.
PrivacyPolicy.InformationSharingandDisclosureText: We do not share your personal information with third parties except as described in this Privacy Policy.
PrivacyPolicy.ServiceProvidersText: We may share your information with trusted third-party providers who assist us in app functionality, data analysis, and weather report services.
PrivacyPolicy.LegalRequirementsText: We may disclose your information to comply with legal obligations or in response to valid requests by public authorities.
PrivacyPolicy.AggregatedDataText: Non-identifiable data may be shared for research and statistical purposes to improve the agricultural industry.
PrivacyPolicy.SecurityOfYourInformationText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information. However, no online platform is entirely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please notify us of any suspected security breaches.
PrivacyPolicy.YourPrivacyChoicesText: You can manage your privacy settings through the App, including enabling/disabling location services. You may also request data access, updates, or deletion as per applicable data protection laws.
PrivacyPolicy.ChildrensPrivacyText: Our App is not intended for individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors.
PrivacyPolicy.UpdatestothisPrivacyPolicyText: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The latest version will always be available in the App. Your continued use of our App after changes are made will constitute acceptance of the updated policy.
